text: Both test jobs run one roster, `tools/ci-suites`: `utilz test` for the dispatcher and for every utility `utilz list` names except prez, through the tree's bin/utilz, stopping at the first failure and refusing an empty list. test-linux's log at the sweep's push, and test-macos's at its first run after it, a `candidate/` push or a dispatch, each have one `== <utility> ==` line per utility.
